description.narrative: Development Objectives: to ensure the efficient coordination in the planning and operation of Ho Chi Minh City's growing public transport system by supporting the municipal government in the structuring of a Public Transport Authority. IDF grant will be utilized to finance the following activities: Component 1: Feasibility study of a PTA for HCMC (US$200.000). Analyze the institutional and regulatory arrangements pertaining to public transport planning and operations in HCMC, and the necessary modifications needed to establish a PTA.Define the organizational structure, job profiles, and resources needed for thePTA to function. Develop an operations manual laying out the procedures for thePTA to carry out its functions and its interaction with all the other sector/line agencies. Component 2: Capacity building (US$80.000). Provide complementary capacity building activities (workshops, seminars, etc.) in relation to the best international practice and feasible options for HCMC in terms of institutional arrangements in the public transport sector and coordinated planning, implementation and operation of services. The objective of this project is to ensure the efficient coordination in the planning and operation of Ho Chi Minh City's growing public transport system by supporting the municipal government in the structuring of a Public Transport Authority.
